finding.headline: "The 2-Hour Rule Road Trip"
finding.problem: "Google says stop every 2 hours for positional asphyxia. My husband says 'he's sleeping, don't wake him.' I'm terrified but don't know the facts."
finding.person: Family driving 4–6h to the village for naming/Christmas; baby in seat too long.
